message: `loud` performs IO and its declaration does not say so
help: write `;@axiom:effect(io)` above the declaration. Effects are INFERRED transitively, so this fires on every function up the call chain, and each one is a place a reader would otherwise have to open the callee to learn it. If the effect is not wanted here the fix is to stop performing it, not to stop saying so; `Alloc` and `Mut` are ambient and never need declaring
